name: Berard's Journal
summary: In Pyrewood Village, Berard's Journal holds research the Royal Apothecary Society needs. Berard studied an ancient plague that wiped out the aquatic life of Lake Lordamere.

sections.title: Lost Research of Lake Lordamere
sections.body: Before Arugal's shadow magic spread across Silverpine Forest, Apothecary Berard was one of the Royal Apothecary Society's most promising minds. From Pyrewood Village, he studied an ancient blight that had wiped out all aquatic life in Lake Lordamere centuries earlier. When Arugal's curse gripped the settlement, Berard lost his mind and became a thrall. His detailed field notes remained on a bookshelf in his quarters at the Pyrewood Village Inn.

sections.title: Fuel for the New Plague
sections.body: Berard's research survived, though Berard himself was lost to the Society. At the Sepulcher, Apothecary Renferrel recognizes its value and sends Forsaken agents into the hostile village to recover the journal. The notes on the ancient lake toxin give Master Apothecary Faranell and the Society in the Apothecarium groundwork for concocting the Forsaken's own new plague.

faq.answer: Apothecary Berard was a gifted member of the Royal Apothecary Society who lived in Pyrewood Village. He studied ancient toxins when Archmage Arugal cursed the region, breaking Berard's mind and enslaving him.
Berard's Journal rests on a bookshelf in his old study, on the upper floor of the inn in Pyrewood Village, deep in southern Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: What research is recorded in the journal?
faq.answer: The journal records Berard's findings on an ancient contagion that wiped out all aquatic life in Lake Lordamere. The Royal Apothecary Society hopes to adapt its toxic properties for their own chemical weapons.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Renferrel want the journal?
faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel wants to recover useful research before it is destroyed or lost. Berard's findings on the Lake Lordamere contagion provide components Master Apothecary Faranell needs in Undercity to develop the Forsaken's new plague.

angles.text: As an Undead, every scrap of venomous lore helps the Royal Apothecary Society secure a weapon to defend the Forsaken against the Scourge and living enemies.
As a member of the Horde, reclaiming lost research in Pyrewood Village helps the Forsaken build a firm defensive stronghold across Silverpine Forest.
